scene childofman1
The stars sink into the sea sometime after the sky goes to sleep.
lines.zh: 在天空入睡之后的某个时刻，群星沉入大海。

lines.en: It’s silent.
lines.zh: 一片寂静。

lines.en: But I find solace in the sensation of sand on the soles of my shoes.
lines.zh: 但鞋底踩到沙子的触感，让我找到了一丝慰藉。

lines.en: And while the slight semblance of my soul slips into the surface, it still seems as if a siren song is summoning me forward.
lines.zh: 而当我灵魂中那一点点残影滑入表层时，仍仿佛有一支塞壬的歌在召唤我向前。

lines.en: So I go.
lines.zh: 于是我走了下去。

lines.en: I go. I go. I go. I go. I go.
lines.zh: 我走。我走。我走。我走。我走。

lines.en: But where?
lines.zh: 可要去哪儿？

lines.en: And when did the sun set?
lines.zh: 太阳是什么时候落下的？

lines.en: {i}Why{/i} did the sun set?
lines.zh: 太阳{i}为什么{/i}落下？

lines.en: And who is the siren?
lines.zh: 而那位塞壬又是谁？

lines.en: I press my hands together and glance down to see my fingers interlocking with one another, emulating the sensation of something I have not felt in quite some time.
lines.zh: 我双手合十，低头看见十指彼此交扣，模拟着某种我已经很久没有感受过的感觉。

lines.en: Of course I’ve felt flesh on flesh- but not in a way that amounted to any more than just that.
lines.zh: 我当然感受过肌肤相贴——但从来都只是肌肤相贴而已，再无更多。

lines.en: Even those I am closer with than I am to my own reflection mean nothing when there is a complete lack of understanding.
lines.zh: 当理解彻底缺席时，就连那些与我比自己的倒影还要亲近的人，也毫无意义。

lines.en: And if there is anything I understand, it’s that.
lines.zh: 而如果说我还有什么理解的东西，那就是这一点。

lines.en: Everything else is ephemeral.
lines.zh: 其他一切都是转瞬即逝的。

lines.en: It’s gone just as quickly as it appears.
lines.zh: 它消失得和出现得一样快。

lines.en: Whether it be a night sky or a trip to a beach, it all fades into nothingness and leaves a trail of destruction clinging to life behind it as it goes.
lines.zh: 无论是一片夜空还是一场海滩之行，一切都会淡入虚无，并在身后留下一条紧贴着生命的毁灭痕迹。

lines.en: It goes. It goes. It goes. It goes. It goes.
lines.zh: 它走。它走。它走。它走。它走。

lines.en: But where?
lines.zh: 可要去哪儿？

lines.en: And when did I become someone whose silhouette does not attach itself to the shoreline?
lines.zh: 而我又是何时变成了那种剪影无法附着在海岸线上的人？

lines.en: No shadow on the ground nor reflection in the water.
lines.zh: 地上没有影子，水里也没有倒影。

lines.en: Typical.
lines.zh: 老样子。

lines.en: I replace “ephemeral” with “ethereal” in my head and let the winter air, laced with water droplets from waves I can’t even see, jump onto my skin and my shirt.
lines.zh: 我在脑袋里把「ephemeral」换成「ethereal」，任凭夹杂着我甚至看不见的海浪水珠的冬日空气，跳上我的皮肤和衬衫。

lines.en: It somehow makes me feel a little less lonely.
lines.zh: 不知怎的，这让我没那么孤独了。

lines.en: I don’t even remember how I got here.
lines.zh: 我甚至不记得自己是怎么到这儿来的。

lines.en: Or when I got here.
lines.zh: 也不记得是什么时候来的。

lines.en: I’m assuming this means I zoned out again but, apparently, was not fortunate enough to bump into anyone to snap me out of it this time around.
lines.zh: 我猜这意味着我又走神了，只不过这次显然没那么走运，没能撞上什么人把我拉回来。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I’m sure I’ll find someone sooner or later.
lines.zh: 我迟早会找到什么人的。

lines.en: scene black
scene childofman2
I find something.
lines.zh: 我找到了什么东西。

lines.en: It’s not something I understand at first glimpse...nor is it something I understand after several more glimpses.
lines.zh: 第一眼我并不理解那是什么……再看好几眼，我也还是不理解。

lines.en: But it appears to be some sort of sanctuary.
lines.zh: 但它看起来像是某种圣所。

lines.en: Did I say sanctuary?
lines.zh: 我说圣所了吗？

lines.en: I meant to say {s}restaurant{/s} sanctuary.
lines.zh: 我是想说，{s}餐厅{/s}圣所。

lines.en: I give up on whatever it is I want to say and direct my full attention to discerning the structure before me-
lines.zh: 我放弃了原本想说的话，把全部注意力都用来分辨眼前的这座建筑——

lines.en: But the lingering scent of pork broth and what I think is fried chicken invades my nostrils and forces me into a state of mild confusion in which I can’t even fully recall how I wound up here.
lines.zh: 但残留在空气里的猪骨汤味，还有我猜是炸鸡的味道，钻进我的鼻孔，把我逼进一种轻微的混乱之中，连自己是怎么走到这儿的都记不全了。

lines.en: I attempt to approach the building, but my legs stiffen up.
lines.zh: 我试图走近那栋建筑，可双腿却僵住了。

lines.en: And then, something extraordinary happens.
lines.zh: 然后，非同寻常的事情发生了。

lines.en: : Hear ye, hear ye.
lines.zh: ：诸位请听，诸位请听。

lines.en: : We, the council of plants, have called upon this meeting to discuss the probability of furthering the development of one-
lines.zh: ：我们植物委员会召开本次会议，是为了商讨进一步推进某位……的发展的可能性——

lines.en: : Uhh...am I reading this correctly?
lines.zh: ：呃……我没看错吧？

lines.en: : The name I have here is “Sensei Arakawa.”
lines.zh: ：我手上的名字是「Sensei Arakawa」。

lines.en: : We couldn’t figure out his full name, so we just put what all of the girls have been calling him.
lines.zh: ：我们查不出他的全名，所以就照女生们平时对他的称呼写了。

lines.en: : Wasn’t it Steve? I could have sworn the tomboy one called him that recently.
lines.zh: ：不是 Steve 吗？我敢发誓最近那个假小子就是这么叫他的。

lines.en: : Which tomboy? The one who rips her hair out? Or the one he almost [rape]d on the bridge that one time?
lines.zh: ：哪个假小子？是那个把自己头发扯下来的？还是他有一次在桥上差点[rape]的那个？

lines.en: : The first one, with the hair.
lines.zh: ：第一个，扯头发的那个。

lines.en: : God, I want to lick her thighs.
lines.zh: ：天啊，我想舔她的大腿。

lines.en: : Of course you do, you fucking lolicon.
lines.zh: ：你当然想了，你这个该死的萝莉控。

lines.en: : Order, order.
lines.zh: ：肃静，肃静。

lines.en: : As exciting as it would be to sit here and discuss our sexual fantasies, we must now take into consideration the fact that the beach trip is halfway over and barely anything has been accomplished.
lines.zh: ：虽然坐在这里讨论我们的性幻想很让人兴奋，但我们必须考虑到一个事实：海滩之行已经过半，却几乎什么都没达成。

lines.en: : Well, what exactly were we hoping to accomplish again? We’re just plants. It’s not like we can actually...you know, “further development” or whatever.
lines.zh: ：话说回来，我们到底想达成什么来着？我们只是植物啊。我们又不可能真的……那个，「推进发展」什么的。

lines.en: : No, we certainly can not. But we can-
lines.zh: ：不，我们当然不能。但我们可以——

lines.en: : Woah woah woah. Wait a second. Isn’t that him right there?
lines.zh: ：哇哦哇哦哇哦。等一下。那边那个不就是他吗？

lines.en: : Oh, shit.
lines.zh: ：哦，操。

lines.en: : What do we do?
lines.zh: ：我们怎么办？

lines.en: : Just...just stay quiet. It’s not like he can hear us or anything.
lines.zh: ：就……就保持安静。他又听不见我们说话什么的。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: ：你们好。

lines.en: : Did he just fucking say, “Hello?”
lines.zh: ：他刚刚是不是说了句「你们好」？

lines.en: : He totally just said, “Hello.”
lines.zh: ：他绝对是说了「你们好」。

lines.en: : Why are all of you plants talking about me?
lines.zh: ：你们这些植物为什么都在谈论我？

lines.en: : Umm, better question. Who’s got the tighter pussy? Makoto or Chika?
lines.zh: ：嗯，问个更好的问题。谁的小穴更紧？Makoto 还是 Chika？

lines.en: : Chika 100%%. Makoto’s a little tramp, remember?
lines.zh: ：100%% 是 Chika。Makoto 是个小荡妇，记得吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. There’s no way a girl can grow up around that many sex toys and not do a little bit of experimenting if you know what I’m saying?
lines.zh: ：对啊。一个女生在那么多性玩具堆里长大，不可能不做点实验吧，你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : That only has a {i}slight{/i} bearing on a girl’s vaginal tightness, idiot.
lines.zh: ：那对女生小穴的紧致度只有{i}一点点{/i}影响，白痴。

lines.en: : This is exactly what the narrator was talking about in “Something Everyone Knows and Ignores.”
lines.zh: ：这正是旁白在《人人都知道、却都选择无视的事》里讲的那种东西。

lines.en: : Ughhhhhhh please no. That fucking alphabet song {i}just{/i} stopped being stuck in my head.
lines.zh: ：呃啊啊啊啊啊别。那首该死的字母歌{i}好不容易才{/i}从我脑子里消停。

lines.en: : A! Apple!
lines.zh: ：A！Apple！

lines.en: : B! Banana!
lines.zh: ：B！Banana！

lines.en: : Order, order!
lines.zh: ：肃静，肃静！

lines.en: : Can someone please explain to me where we are right now? Or...why you guys can talk?
lines.zh: ：谁能跟我解释一下我们现在在哪儿吗？或者……你们为什么会说话？

lines.en: : Uhh...how should we put this-
lines.zh: ：呃……这该怎么说呢——

lines.en: : It’s all a hallucination, isn’t it?
lines.zh: ：这一切都是幻觉，对吧？

lines.en: : A hallucination?
lines.zh: ：幻觉？

lines.en: : Uhhh yeah! None of this is actually happening right now! You’re just dreaming!
lines.zh: ：呃对！现在这一切根本没在发生！你只是在做梦！

lines.en: : Buuuuut if this {i}wasn’t{/i} a dream, you’d find yourself standing at a ramen shop at the edge of the world!
lines.zh: ：不——过如果这{i}不是{/i}梦，你会发现自己正站在世界边缘的一家拉面店门口！

lines.en: : No, idiot. The edge of the world is the roof. Do you even fucking read the events?
lines.zh: ：不对，白痴。世界边缘是天台。你他妈到底看没看过剧情啊？

lines.en: : Petition to kick out Plant #3 from the group?
lines.zh: ：提议把 3 号植物踢出群，有人附议吗？

lines.en: : No petition necessary.
lines.zh: ：不必提议。

lines.en: : Plant #3...we, the Plant Council, in accordance with Plant Law...find you guilty on all counts of being entirely unlikable and mildly annoying.
lines.zh: ：3 号植物……我们植物委员会，依据植物法……判定你在「完全不讨人喜欢」与「略微惹人烦」的所有罪名上，全部成立。

lines.en: : Wait! No! I can’t get kicked out! I have saplings to feed!
lines.zh: ：等等！不要！我不能出局！我还有树苗要养！

lines.en: : Sorry, man. That’s just the way the chrysanthemum crumbles.
lines.zh: ：抱歉了，老兄。菊花就是这么碎的。

lines.en: : That’s not even a plant! It’s a flower!
lines.zh: ：那根本不是植物！那是花！

lines.en: : Plants, flowers, what’s the difference?
lines.zh: ：植物也好花也好，有什么区别？

lines.en: : A lot! For starters, plants-
lines.zh: ：区别可大了！首先，植物——

lines.en: scene childofman3
The cactus turns into a skull and the meeting adjourns.
lines.zh: 仙人掌变成了一颗骷髅，会议就此散会。

lines.en: : Good fucking riddance. I bet that guy wasn’t even a Plantreon supporter.
lines.zh: ：该死的，总算走了。我敢打赌那家伙连 Plantreon 的支持者都不是。

lines.en: : He was. I bumped into his wife at Whole Foods a few weeks ago and we talked about it for a little while.
lines.zh: ：他是。几周前我在 Whole Foods 撞见他老婆，我们还聊了一会儿。

lines.en: : Really nice family. I’m actually feeling kind of bad now.
lines.zh: ：一家人真的很好。我现在反倒有点过意不去了。

lines.en: : Petition to remove Plant #2 from the Plant Council?
lines.zh: ：提议把 2 号植物从植物委员会除名？

lines.en: : Petition denied.
lines.zh: ：提议驳回。

lines.en: : Asshole.
lines.zh: ：混蛋。

lines.en: : Can someone please tell me what’s going on?
lines.zh: ：谁能告诉我到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : Dude, just go into the shop. You weren’t even supposed to stop and talk to us.
lines.zh: ：老兄，进店里去就行。你本来就不该停下来跟我们说话的。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not every day I bump into a group of inanimate objects having a conversation with one another.
lines.zh: ：我是说，一群没有生命的物体聚在一起聊天，这种事可不是天天都能碰上的。

lines.en: : Let alone a conversation about “furthering my development.”
lines.zh: ：更别提聊的还是「推进我的发展」。

lines.en: : Ugh, great. Now I have to file an I-35 and explain to the {i}Supreme{/i} Plant Council why there was another deviation.
lines.zh: ：呃，好极了。现在我得填一份 I-35，向{i}最高{/i}植物委员会解释为什么又出现了一次偏差。

lines.en: : There sure have been a lot of those lately...Do you think it’s something we should worry about?
lines.zh: ：最近这种偏差还真多啊……你觉得我们需要担心吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s fine. It’s just his memories trying to come back or whatever, isn't it?
lines.zh: ：我肯定没事。大概只是他的记忆在试图回来什么的吧？

lines.en: : Whatever it is, it won’t do us any good to continue discussing it while he’s right there listening.
lines.zh: ：不管是什么，他就在旁边听着，我们再讨论下去也没好处。

lines.en: : Anyway! This concludes the ninety-seventh gathering of District 23’s Plant Council!
lines.zh: ：总之！第 23 区植物委员会第九十七次集会到此结束！

lines.en: : Please remember to keep everything discussed here classified from any and all interested parties, and feel free to help yourself to a croissant on the way out.
lines.zh: ：请记住，今天在此讨论的一切都要对所有相关方保密，出门时请随意取用一个可颂。

lines.en: : Croissants are for girls.
lines.zh: ：可颂是给女生吃的。

lines.en: : Hah. I get it.
lines.zh: ：哈。我懂。

lines.en: scene childofman4
I stare blankly at a set of chairs before me.
lines.zh: 我茫然地盯着面前的一排椅子。

lines.en: There is a skull on one of them.
lines.zh: 其中一把椅子上有一颗骷髅。

lines.en: I feel like I’m forgetting something.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己忘了点什么。

scene inmemorium
scene black
scene childofman5
I walk into the strange building to be met with the surprising sight of one girl I’ve had sex with and one girl I’m going to have sex with.
lines.zh: 我走进那栋奇怪的建筑，迎面撞见的景象让我有些意外：一个我已经上过的女生，和一个我以后会上的女生。

lines.en: Their names are Makoto and Touka and they are both relatively unpopular, each for different reasons.
lines.zh: 她们叫 Makoto 和 Touka，两个人都算不上受欢迎，原因各不相同。

lines.en: But I’m glad to see that they’ve found company in one another.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴看到她们在彼此身上找到了陪伴。

lines.en: : Hey, you two. How are things?
lines.zh: ：嘿，你们两个。还好吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean, “How are things?” What is wrong with you?
lines.zh: ：你「还好吗」是什么意思？你脑子出问题了吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: ：什么？

lines.en: : Sensei...you’ve been standing there looking...lost for a fair amount of time now.
lines.zh: ：Sensei……你站在那里，一副……迷路的样子，已经好一会儿了。

lines.en: : And let’s not gloss over the fact that you played out an entire plant-based roleplay scenario of sorts.
lines.zh: ：还有，我们可别略过你刚才演了一整出以植物为主角的角色扮演这种事。

lines.en: : Did Noriko drug you again? Because I explicitly told her to not do that.
lines.zh: ：Noriko 又给你下药了？我可是明确跟她说过不许那么做的。

lines.en: : Plant...roleplay?
lines.zh: ：植物……角色扮演？

lines.en: : There was a fatality and everything. It was actually rather touching in a...very strange sort of way.
lines.zh: ：还死了人呢。说实话，还挺感人的——以一种……非常奇怪的方式。

lines.en: : Nevermind that. Would one of you mind telling me where exactly we are right now?
lines.zh: ：先别管那个。你们谁能告诉我，我们现在到底在哪儿？

lines.en: scene childofman6
: Oh, this old place?
lines.zh: ：哦，这间老店吗？

lines.en: : It’s just an extra restaurant my family had lying around.
lines.zh: ：只是我家闲置的一家多余的餐厅罢了。

lines.en: : I informed my father that there weren’t many options for us to choose from for dinner, so he had this one airlifted over.
lines.zh: ：我跟我父亲说，我们晚餐没什么选择，他就让人把这家空运过来了。

lines.en: : I envy the sort of life that leads to you having “extra” restaurants lying around.
lines.zh: ：我真羡慕你这种「多余」的餐厅随手就有的生活。

lines.en: : I actually quite like this one despite its rather drab decor and strange scent.
lines.zh: ：其实我还挺喜欢这家的，虽然装修挺单调，味道也有点怪。

lines.en: : It’s not really strange. That’s just kind of...how ramen smells.
lines.zh: ：其实也不算怪。拉面……本来就是那个味道。

lines.en: scene childofman7
: Is that so?
lines.zh: ：是这样吗？

lines.en: : I don’t typically eat things this inexpensive, so I was unaware it was commonplace.
lines.zh: ：我平时不怎么吃这么便宜的东西，所以不知道那是常见的味道。

lines.en: : So you two are just...hanging out at a secret ramen shop Touka’s family had airlifted in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: ：所以你们两个就……在 Touka 家半夜空运过来的秘密拉面店里闲逛？

lines.en: scene childofman8
: That’s not all, Sensei. Makoto was actually helping me study.
lines.zh: ：不止如此呢，Sensei。Makoto 其实在帮我复习功课。

lines.en: : Study? You {i}do{/i} realize we’re on vacation, right?
lines.zh: ：复习？你该知道我们现在在度假吧？

lines.en: : Neither of us had anything else to do, so...
lines.zh: ：我们俩也没别的事可做，所以……

lines.en: : I also find learning to be quite fun! And since swimming is out of the question given the weather, it only made sense for us to seize this opportunity to get something done.
lines.zh: ：而且我觉得学习很有趣！既然这种天气没法游泳，那我们抓住这个机会做点正事，也就顺理成章了。

lines.en: : Wow. If only someone who cared a little less about studying would show up right about now...
lines.zh: ：哇。要是此刻能出现一个不那么爱学习的人就好了……

lines.en: : Woah...
lines.zh: ：哇哦……

lines.en: : What...is this place?...
lines.zh: ：这……是什么地方？……

lines.en: scene childofman9
A hidden audience erupts into applause as Chika finds her way into the secret Tsukioka ramen shop at the edge of the world that isn’t actually the edge of the world maybe.
lines.zh: 当 Chika 找到路走进那家位于世界边缘、但也许其实并不是世界边缘的 Tsukioka 家秘密拉面店时，一群隐藏的观众爆发出掌声。

lines.en: : Oh, Chika! You showed up after all.
lines.zh: ：哦，Chika！你果然来了。

lines.en: : I’m assuming this is where our study-session concludes then?
lines.zh: ：那么我猜，我们的学习会就到此为止了？

lines.en: : Oh, don’t be silly. I’m sure Chika also sees the value in utilizing free time to become a better, more knowledgeable, person.
lines.zh: ：哦，别傻了。我相信 Chika 也明白利用空闲时间成为更好、更有学识的人的价值。

lines.en: : Isn’t that right, Chika?
lines.zh: ：对吧，Chika？

lines.en: : Chika? Hello?
lines.zh: ：Chika？喂？

lines.en: : Hey.
scene childofman10
: Oh! Hey!
lines.zh: ：哦！嗨！

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were here too, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：我不知道你也在这儿，Sensei。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, even I didn’t realize I was here until a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: ：别担心，连我自己都是几分钟前才意识到我在这儿。

lines.en: : Oh, you. You’re so funny. No wonder you and I are-
lines.zh: ：哦，你呀。你真幽默。难怪你和我——

lines.en: : Two people with a totally normal relationship not worth mentioning to anyone else?
lines.zh: ：是两个关系完全正常、不值得跟任何人提起的人？

lines.en: scene childofman11
Chika’s clothes dissolve into nothingness, but her scarf remains intact because she would get cold otherwise.
lines.zh: Chika 的衣服溶解成了虚无，但她的围巾完好无损地留了下来，因为不然她会着凉。

lines.en: A fish stares up at me from the ground outside of the restaurant, gasping for breath but incapable of breathing because...uhh, water.
lines.zh: 一条鱼在餐厅外的地面上仰头瞪着我，大口喘气却无法呼吸，因为……呃，水。

lines.en: I don’t know the sciencey explanation for it.
lines.zh: 我不知道这个的科学解释是什么。

lines.en: It’s reverse drowning.
lines.zh: 这是反向溺水。

lines.en: : Makoto, can you explain what the fish is doing?
lines.zh: ：Makoto，你能解释一下那条鱼在干什么吗？

lines.en: : Fish? What fish?
lines.zh: ：鱼？什么鱼？

lines.en: : Could he be referring to one of our bowls of cheap commoner noodles?
lines.zh: ：他说的会不会是我们那几碗便宜的平民面条里的一碗？

lines.en: : I could stand here and stare at you for the rest of eternity and not regret even a second of it.
lines.zh: ：我可以就这么站在原地盯着你看，直到永恒尽头，连一秒都不会后悔。

lines.en: : But what about Chinami?
lines.zh: ：那 Chinami 怎么办？

lines.en: : Hm? What’s this about Chinami?
lines.zh: ：嗯？Chinami 怎么了？

lines.en: scene childofman12
: Yumi?
lines.zh: ：Yumi？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh yup. That’s my name, asshole.
lines.zh: ：呃呃呃呃对。那就是我的名字，混蛋。

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: ：你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I work here, asshole.
lines.zh: ：我在这儿工作啊，混蛋。

lines.en: : Since when?
lines.zh: ：从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: : Since you helped me get a job here. Remember, asshole?
lines.zh: ：从你帮我在这儿找到这份工作开始。记得吗，混蛋？

lines.en: : I don’t remember that at all.
lines.zh: ：我完全不记得有这回事。

lines.en: : Really? You don’t remember the entire arc about my mom and me reconnecting? And me discovering that I’m a product of her being knocked up while unconscious, asshole?
lines.zh: ：是吗？你不记得我妈和我修复关系的那一整段剧情了？也不记得我发现自己是她昏迷时被搞大肚子才有的产物了，混蛋？

lines.en: : Do you even pay any attention to me at all, asshole?
lines.zh: ：你到底有没有正眼看过我啊，混蛋？

lines.en: : Or are you just here to kill the pain, asshole?
lines.zh: ：还是说你来这儿只是为了止痛，混蛋？

lines.en: : Pain?
lines.zh: ：止痛？

lines.en: : What pain?
lines.zh: ：止什么痛？

lines.en: : Senseiiiiiiii~ Look at meeeeeeee~
lines.zh: ：Sensei——～看看我——嘛～

lines.en: scene childofman11
I look at Chika.
lines.zh: 我看着 Chika。

lines.en: scene childofman13
And then I look back at Yumi again.
lines.zh: 然后我又回头看向 Yumi。

lines.en: : Hey, asshole.
lines.zh: ：嘿，混蛋。

lines.en: : Do you remember all of those detentions you used to give me back before you regained your own body (If that is what is actually happening here), asshole?
lines.zh: ：你还记得吗，在你拿回自己的身体之前（如果现在发生的真是这么回事的话），你罚过我那么多次留校，混蛋？

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: ：不记得。

lines.en: : I don’t remember anything from before the first time I “woke up” in[school] again.
lines.zh: ：我什么都不记得了，除了第一次在[school]里再次「醒来」之后的事。

lines.en: : There was something you said to me during one of those that really stuck with me, asshole.
lines.zh: ：其中有一次你对我说过的话，我一直记到现在，混蛋。

lines.en: : And what was that?
lines.zh: ：是什么话？

lines.en: : That I was wasting my potential, asshole.
lines.zh: ：你说我在浪费自己的潜力，混蛋。

lines.en: : And that stuck with you?
lines.zh: ：那句话一直留到现在？

lines.en: : Yeah. But not in a good way, asshole.
lines.zh: ：是啊。但不是什么好方式，混蛋。

lines.en: : Because, from my perspective, there was never any potential there, asshole.
lines.zh: ：因为在我看来，我从来就没有什么潜力，混蛋。

lines.en: : I’ve been nothing but an abomination of failures stitched together since the moment I popped out of my junkie mom, asshole.
lines.zh: ：从我那个瘾君子妈把我生下来的那一刻起，我就不过是一堆失败缝合起来的怪物，混蛋。

lines.en: : And having some guy who knows nothing about me pretend to know my potential was even worse than the time you [[redacted].
lines.zh: ：而让一个对我一无所知的家伙假装了解我的潜力，甚至比你那次[[redacted]还要糟。

lines.en: : Asshole.
lines.zh: ：混蛋。

lines.en: scene childofman14
: I missed you.
lines.zh: ：我想你了。

lines.en: : ...Maya?
lines.zh: ：……Maya？

lines.en: scene childofman15
: Maya?
lines.zh: ：Maya？

lines.en: : Is everything okay, Sensei?
lines.zh: ：你还好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You’ve been standing there looking...lost for a fair amount of time now.
lines.zh: ：你站在那里，一副……迷路的样子，已经好一会儿了。

lines.en: : Wait, has...Chika been here? Or Yumi?
lines.zh: ：等等，Chika 有……来过吗？或者 Yumi？

lines.en: : Neither of those two have been-
lines.zh: ：她们两个都没有——

lines.en: scene childofman16
: Woah...
lines.zh: ：哇哦……

lines.en: : What...
lines.zh: ：什么……

lines.en: : What is this place?
lines.zh: ：这是什么地方？

lines.en: scene childofman17
: Oh, this is where you were? I’ve been looking all over for you.
lines.zh: ：哦，原来你在这儿啊？我到处都在找你。

lines.en: : Why haven’t you been answering your phone?
lines.zh: ：你为什么不回我电话？

lines.en: : My phone?
lines.zh: ：我的电话？

lines.en: I slide my phone out of my pocket to find that I have several missed calls and an entire string of text messages from Chika spanning over the course of the last three hours.
lines.zh: 我把手机从口袋里掏出来，发现有好几个未接来电，还有一长串 Chika 发来的短信，时间跨度是最近三个小时。

lines.en: : How did...
lines.zh: ：你怎么……

lines.en: : How did you know she would be here?
lines.zh: ：你怎么知道她会在这儿？

lines.en: : Is there an emergency or something?
lines.zh: ：是有什么急事吗？

lines.en: scene childofman18
: I just...you know...
lines.zh: ：我只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Whatever brought you here, Chika, I do implore you to sit down and try these lower middle class ramen noodles! They are absolutely splendid!
lines.zh: ：不管你是为什么来的，Chika，我都恳请你坐下尝尝这些中下阶层的拉面！它们简直棒极了！

lines.en: scene childofman19
: Oh! Thank you!
lines.zh: ：哦！谢谢！

lines.en: : I was starting to think I wouldn’t be having dinner at all tonight.
lines.zh: ：我刚才还在想，今晚大概根本吃不上晚饭了。

lines.en: : Do you think it’d be okay if I packed some up for Yumi as well? Girl didn’t even eat breakfast today.
lines.zh: ：我能不能也打包一些给 Yumi？那丫头今天连早饭都没吃。

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat at the counter and order from one of the Tsukioka family servants or...employees or something.
lines.zh: 我在吧台前坐下，向 Tsukioka 家的一位仆人……还是说雇工什么的点了单。

lines.en: He doesn’t speak at all, but he nods after I place my order and brings me a fresh bowl of soup just minutes later.
lines.zh: 他一句话也没说，只是在我点完单后点了点头，几分钟后就给我端来一碗热腾腾的汤。

lines.en: Before I know it, the girls and I are choking down piping hot lower middle class ramen noodles.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，我和女生们就稀里呼噜地吃起了滚烫的中下阶层拉面。

lines.en: They’re good.
lines.zh: 挺好吃的。

lines.en: Not Tojo Ramen good, but still good.
lines.zh: 没有 Tojo Ramen 那么好吃，但也算好吃。

lines.en: I think mine had cactus in it.
lines.zh: 我觉得我这碗里放了仙人掌。

lines.en: scene childofman20
We leave the secret ramen shop and Makoto and Touka proceed to have some sort of formal, smart person conversation that I can’t be bothered to pay attention to.
lines.zh: 我们离开那家秘密拉面店，Makoto 和 Touka 接着开始了某种正式的、聪明人之间的对话，我懒得去听。

lines.en: Instead, I focus my gaze on stars sinking into the sea and find myself getting lost in a sea of my own.
lines.zh: 相反，我凝望着沉入大海的群星，然后发现自己迷失在了一片属于我自己的海里。

lines.en: Not of water, but of skepticism and a heavy dose of regret.
lines.zh: 那不是水的海，而是怀疑与浓重悔恨的海。

lines.en: Not the type of regret that results from making a poor decision, but the kind that comes from feeling like you’ve wasted too much time.
lines.zh: 不是做了错误决定带来的那种悔恨，而是觉得自己浪费了太多时间的那种。

lines.en: But that shouldn’t be an issue for me.
lines.zh: 但这对我来说本不该是个问题。

lines.en: I have as much time as the world can offer.
lines.zh: 世界能给我多少时间，我就有多少时间。

lines.en: But still-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: I feel like yet another chunk of my life has been ripped away from me.
lines.zh: 我还是觉得，生命中又有一块被从我身上撕走了。

lines.en: Or out of me.
lines.zh: 或者说，从我体内撕走了。

lines.en: Something is missing.
lines.zh: 有什么东西不见了。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: ：Sensei？

lines.en: scene childofman21
: Yeah?
: You okay?
lines.zh: ：你还好吗？

lines.en: : I’m fine. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: ：我没事。为什么这么问？

lines.en: : Obviously cause you look...not okay.
lines.zh: ：很明显啊，因为你看上去……不太好。

lines.en: : Whatever it is will pass. I’m probably just tired.
lines.zh: ：不管是什么都会过去的。我大概只是累了。

lines.en: : Long day?
lines.zh: ：今天很长？

lines.en: : Yes and no.
lines.zh: ：是，也不是。

lines.en: : Mostly yes, I think.
lines.zh: ：我觉得大部分是的。

lines.en: : Anything I can do to make you feel better?
lines.zh: ：有什么我能做的，让你好受一点吗？

lines.en: : Not with those two around.
lines.zh: ：有她们俩在旁边就不行。

lines.en: scene childofman22
: I see, I see.
lines.zh: ：这样啊，这样啊。

lines.en: : Come with me then.
lines.zh: ：那就跟我来。

lines.en: : Come with you where?
lines.zh: ：跟你去哪儿？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Just come.
lines.zh: ：我不知道。来就是了。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: ：可是——

lines.en: : They’re talking about smart person stuff. They won’t even realize we’re gone.
lines.zh: ：她们在聊聪明人的东西。她们根本不会发现我们走了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure they’ll still realize if-
lines.zh: ：我很确定她们还是会发现的，如果——

lines.en: : Shush.
: On the count of three, we turn around and start walking toward the woods.
lines.zh: ：数到三，我们就转身往树林里走。

lines.en: : Chika...
lines.zh: ：Chika……

lines.en: : One...
scene childofman23
: Two...
scene black
: Three.
scene childofman24
: Wait, where did Sensei and Chika go? Weren’t they just here?
lines.zh: ：等等，Sensei 和 Chika 去哪儿了？他们刚才不是还在这儿吗？

lines.en: : I believe so...but I don’t recall them ever leaving.
lines.zh: ：应该是吧……但我不记得他们有离开过。

lines.en: : Perhaps they forgot something at my spare restaurant?
lines.zh: ：也许是有什么东西落在我那间备用餐厅里了？

lines.en: : Perhaps.
lines.zh: ：也许吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Let’s just head back to the inn, I guess...
lines.zh: ：那我们就先回旅馆吧，我想……
